culture-cycles.note: The patron-saint day is a school holiday in this state. The ministry lists it apart from the statutory public holidays, so do not assume shops or businesses close; the ministry page does not say.

laws.rule: Lower Austria says that where a district forest-fire ordinance applies, lighting any fire, including campfires and barbecues, is prohibited in woodland and the danger zone nearby. The state publishes a list of district orders; check the order for the actual location and date. Separate safety requirements apply outside that restriction.
laws.heading: Brauchtumsfeuer, Lagerfeuer & Grillfeuer

laws.rule: Lower Austria's overnight tax (Nächtigungstaxe) is EUR 3.00 per person per night in spa municipalities and EUR 2.60 elsewhere (about A$4.77 and A$4.13 at EUR 0.6293 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026), under section 15(1) of the NÖ Tourismusgesetz 2023. Both amounts are indexed to consumer prices each 1 January from 2026 (section 15(2)), so the figure in force for 2026 may be a little higher; that notice was not read. Exempt (section 14): people up to the end of their 15th year, school stays, military or civil service, apprentices, asylum applicants, stays over two months from the third month, nursing homes, and mountain huts with mainly dormitory beds. The councils collect it for the Land (section 10).
laws.heading: NÖ TourG 2023, sections 10, 14 and 15

laws.rule: Lower Austria: Curfew for minors in public places and at public events (the Jugendschutz rule): young people up to the end of their 14th year may be out only from 05:00 to 23:00, and up to the end of their 16th year only from 05:00 to 01:00, unless they have an accompanying person or a justified reason such as heading home (section 15 of the NÖ Jugendgesetz).
laws.heading: NÖ Jugendgesetz, section 15

laws.rule: Lower Austria: under 16, buying, having or drinking alcohol (including mixed drinks) in public places and at public events is banned; under 18 the same applies to drinks with distilled alcohol (section 18(1) and (2) of the NÖ Jugendgesetz).
laws.heading: NÖ Jugendgesetz, section 18

laws.rule: Lower Austria: under 18, buying, having or using tobacco products and related products (including water pipes) in public places and at public events is banned (section 18(2) of the NÖ Jugendgesetz).
laws.heading: NÖ Jugendgesetz, section 18(2)

items.text: Lower Austria's youth-protection law (NÖ Jugendgesetz, section 18) applies at generally accessible places and public events. Under 16: no alcohol, including mixed drinks. From 16 to 18: beer and wine are allowed, but not spirits. Under 18 is the usual cut-off, except a person who is married or serving in the Bundesheer or Zivildienst. Fines: an adult without profit, up to EUR 700 (about A$1,112); an adult acting for profit, or a business, up to EUR 15,000 (about A$23,836); a young person may be required to attend a talk or do social work, with a substitute fine of EUR 200 (about A$318).

psychoactive-substances.notes: These are Land youth-protection rules, not a general adult drinking age of 18 for beer or wine. They apply to visitors under 18 in this Land. Federal narcotics law is not restated here. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293. Official RIS consolidated text (Geltende Fassung) read directly on 11 November 2026.
